items.reason: A gentle, active-free cleanser keeps your skin feeling clean without stripping it.
A simple ceramide moisturizer supports your skin's comfort and moisture balance.
A mineral SPF 50 is the most useful habit for keeping skin looking its best as you get older.

response.routine_note: Cleanse morning and night, moisturize, and apply sunscreen every morning, reapplying if you are outside for long. We left out vitamin C and firming creams because they aren't needed at 15, and this simple routine is easier to stick with.
